description: We are Artifact Duo! Two classmates, coding partners, and senior IT students at New Cairo Technological University (NCTU). Taking on the NASA Space Apps Challenge in the Storytelling track, we bridge the gap between technology and imagination to make space exploration accessible and inspiring for everyone
summary: **Abandoned but Not Forgotten** is a kid-friendly digital museum about NASA machines left behind on the Moon, Mars and in deep space after their missions ended. The site has three pages: a welcome page with photos of the spacecraft, an explore page with each world and its machines (Moon: Surveyor 3, Apollo 11, 12 and 15; Mars: Sojourner, Spirit and Opportunity, Ingenuity; Deep Space: Kepler and Pioneer 10), and a search page to look up any spacecraft by name. Every machine has a five-part story covering why it was built, its adventures, its discoveries, what happened to it, and a science lesson, plus a fun fact. Kids can also check how much they would weigh on the Moon and Mars, and collect explorer stars as they visit each machine. The goal is to make space science simple, playful and memorable.
details: Our project addresses the problem of abandoned human-made equipment left on the Moon and Mars after space missions end. These objects may remain for decades, contributing to space debris and potentially affecting future exploration. Our solution is to develop an interactive platform that identifies, visualizes, and tracks these abandoned objects using NASA's publicly available mission data, images, and planetary datasets. The platform aims to raise awareness and support more sustainable space exploration.
